* '''Playtest''' ([[Tallie Lintra In Blue 1 (Playtest)]], 1 August 2019): Playtest image, published before the set's official release (2 August 2019) and replaced before it. Players Committee card image, 1 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-tallielintrainblue1-20190801.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e26d0f1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/tallielintrainblue1.gif Holotable commit e26d0f1 “Images part 1”]), no mark. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Tallie, who provides ability of 2. May move as a 'react' to same location as your [Episode VII] character. Characters here may not have their forfeit increased beyond their printed value.” The lower-left margin prints “A-Wing”.
* '''Original''' ([[Tallie Lintra In Blue 1]], 2 August 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (2 August 2019). Players Committee card image, 2 August 2019: [[:File:V11-L-tallielintrainblue1-20190802.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/60afbbd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/large/tallielintrainblue1.gif Holotable commit 60afbbd “Using better graphics”]), no mark. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Tallie, who provides ability of 2. May move as a 'react' to same location as your [Episode VII] character. Characters here may not have their forfeit increased above their printed value.” '''What changed:''' before release: “increased beyond their printed value” became “increased above their printed value”; the lower-left margin “A-Wing” became “A-wing”; re-rendered with sharper graphics.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 29 March 2023): Players Committee card image, 29 March 2023: [[:File:V11-L-tallielintrainblue1.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/168657a/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual11-Light/hires/tallielintrainblue1.png Holotable commit 168657a “Set 11 Remastered”]), no mark. Text: “Permanent pilot is •Tallie, who provides ability of 2. May move as a 'react' to same location as your [Episode VII] character. Characters here may not have their forfeit increased above their printed value.” '''What changed:''' Set 11 remaster: same words; re-rendered at high resolution.
*: [[File:V11-L-tallielintrainblue1-20230329-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
